# deadcode_allowlist.txt -- unreachable functions in cmd/... (Rule: deadcode).
#
# Baseline unreachable functions found by `go tool deadcode ./cmd/...`.
# The list only shrinks. Checked in both directions:
# - An entry no longer dead (deleted or made reachable) is stale and fails the test.
# - Any new unreachable function not listed fails the test.
# - NOVA_CI_UPDATE=1 drops stale entries and lowers the ceiling.
#
# ceiling: 1614
